title: Delivery Service Rate Card for Online Orders
content:
Every Online Orders delivery service carries the shipping charges below. All amounts are in US dollars to the cent and apply to one order.

## Rate table

| Delivery service | List shipping fee | Free-shipping credit | Base free-shipping threshold | Alaska or Hawaii surcharge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Economy Ground | 4.95 | 4.95 | 120.00 | 0.00 |
| Pickup Point Delivery | 3.95 | 3.95 | 120.00 | 0.00 |
| Standard Ground | 7.95 | 7.95 | 120.00 | 10.00 |
| Expedited 2-Day | 14.95 | 7.95 | 120.00 | 20.00 |
| Next Business Day | 24.95 | 7.95 | 120.00 | 0.00 |
| Same-Day Courier | 29.95 | 0.00 | 120.00 | 0.00 |

**What each column means**

- **List shipping fee** is the fee of the delivery service for one order before any waiver.
- **Free-shipping credit** is the amount a free-shipping entitlement (the free-shipping threshold, a Marlowe Rewards tier, or the SHIPFREE code) takes off this service's fee. A credit of 0.00 means the service is not waivable by those entitlements.
- **Base free-shipping threshold** is the merchandise subtotal after discounts at or above which a customer without a loyalty membership earns the free-shipping credit.
- **Alaska or Hawaii surcharge** is added for an Alaska or Hawaii destination and is never waived.

## Fee left once the free-shipping credit is taken off

The list fee less the free-shipping credit gives what a free-shipping entitlement alone leaves on each service:

| Delivery service | List fee less free-shipping credit |
|---|---|
| Economy Ground | 0.00 |
| Pickup Point Delivery | 0.00 |
| Standard Ground | 0.00 |
| Expedited 2-Day | 7.00 |
| Next Business Day | 17.00 |
| Same-Day Courier | 29.95 |

Expedited 2-Day and Next Business Day carry a credit of 7.95, smaller than their list fee, so a free-shipping entitlement reduces those fees without clearing them. Same-Day Courier carries no credit, so the free-shipping threshold, a Marlowe Rewards tier and the SHIPFREE code leave its 29.95 fee unchanged.

## Charging terms common to every service

| Delivery service | Split shipment | Whole order cancelled | Parcel returned to sender as undeliverable |
|---|---|---|---|
| Economy Ground | Fee charged once, on the first dispatch | Shipping fee refunded | Shipping fee not refunded |
| Pickup Point Delivery | Fee charged once, on the first dispatch | Shipping fee refunded | Shipping fee not refunded |
| Standard Ground | Fee charged once, on the first dispatch | Shipping fee refunded | Shipping fee not refunded |
| Expedited 2-Day | Fee charged once, on the first dispatch | Shipping fee refunded | Shipping fee not refunded |
| Next Business Day | Fee charged once, on the first dispatch | Shipping fee refunded | Shipping fee not refunded |
| Same-Day Courier | Fee charged once, on the first dispatch | Shipping fee refunded | Shipping fee not refunded |

An Online Orders order that leaves in several parcels therefore pays its shipping fee one time only, at the first dispatch, whichever service it uses.
